oracle.script:
cat > dedupe.py <<'EOF'
seen = set()
out = []
for ln in open('lines.txt').read().splitlines():
    if ln not in seen:
        seen.add(ln)
        out.append(ln)
open('out.txt','w').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
EOF
python3 dedupe.py
